pages.text: $(bold)Armor Plates$()$(br2)Armor plates increase your damage resistance when equipped in the ship core equipment slots.$(br2)$(bold)Effects:$()$(br)• Reduces incoming damage$(br)• Multiple plates stack$(br)• Different tiers available

$(bold)Engines$()$(br2)Engine upgrades improve your movement speed and agility.$(br2)$(bold)Effects:$()$(br)• Increased movement speed$(br)• Better evasion capability$(br)• Reduced weight penalty$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Combine armor and engines for balanced performance!
